# masamune_agora

**Tag**: library

## 简介

Plug-in for Masamune framework to use Agora.io. Includes support for recording.

## 官网

- 主页: https://mathru.net
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/mathrunet/flutter_masamune/tree/master/packages/masamune_agora
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/masamune_agora
